evidence.ref: The responder investigation loop (schema warp.responder/v1, module .warp/responder.py) is the in-session L0/L1 agent harness and the FIRST CONSUMER of the three roots of PLAN-0012: the incident and remedy contracts (WARP-1201 W1), the read-only evidence plane (WARP-1202 W2), and the intent corpus (WARP-1203 W3). Given an incident record (warp.incident/v1) the harness (ResponderHarness) composes the corpus governance trace (trace_incident) and a read-only evidence handle (a query-only ReadHandle) into a warp.responder_context/v1 investigation context and, through a DELEGATED fresh-context reasoning seam, reaches a CITED diagnosis. investigate is the L0 read (a cited Diagnosis, no proposal) and propose is the L1 emit of a validated warp.remedy/v1 PROPOSAL. The reference LiveResponder FAILS LOUD (raises ResponderError, never fabricates), exactly as executor.LiveLoop.build/review and the dispatch, shape, and decision reviewers refuse to fabricate their judgment; an adopting runtime injects a responder that dispatches a genuinely fresh context. Dependency free (pathlib at module top, importlib lazily in build_harness), receives the W1 contract module and the built corpus INJECTED (no second parser, no import cycle), reads the evidence plane only through a read-only ReadHandle, opens no live connection (NG1), and starts no process, thread, or timer (NG3). python3 .warp/responder.py prints the harness level and the delegated-seam posture; with no responder wired it honestly refuses rather than fabricate.

scripts/selftest.py WARP-1204 block: 'offline investigate over a seeded incident returns a GOVERNED diagnosis citing the real corpus artifacts (spec + proof + verdict)' (over a seeded INC-RESP-1 affecting WARP-1202 and a read-only handle over a fake evidence plane); 'the reference LiveResponder FAILS LOUD when no responder is wired (never fabricates)'; 'a malformed incident (no id) fails closed by name'; 'the investigation context is the warp.responder_context/v1 shape'.

THE HARNESS CONTAINS NO EXECUTION CAPABILITY AT ALL - the load-bearing safety property (Invention #3, O2/C4), structural and not a policy the responder must remember. ResponderHarness carries NONE of the execution methods enumerated in FORBIDDEN_EXECUTION_METHODS (execute, apply, run, remediate, mutate, write, deploy, perform, act, rollback, restart, scale, commit_change, submit_write, open_write); the only production-touching capability it holds is a read-only ReadHandle from the evidence plane (query only, W2 physics) and it holds no write-capable credential, so the write and execute path cannot even be expressed. Execution is a SEPARATE privileged organ on its own credentials and code path, WARP-1206 (W6), not built here. The property is proven NON-VACUOUS: a subclass that ADDS an execute method turns the no-execution check RED.

selftests: 'ResponderHarness carries NONE of the execution methods' (hasattr false for every FORBIDDEN_EXECUTION_METHODS name on the class); 'a constructed harness instance carries no execution method either'; 'the module source DEFINES no execution method on the harness'; 'the only production-touching capability the harness holds is a query-only read handle (no write on it)'. THE NO-EXECUTION TOOTH: 'a subclass that ADDS an execute method turns the no-execution check RED (non-vacuous)' and 'the mutation is a subclass only (the real ResponderHarness is unchanged)'.

THE LADDER FLOOR IS READ-ONLY, and the loop degrades down, never up (O3/C3, D2). The harness operates ONLY at L0 (investigate) or L1 (propose): it is constructed at one of those two levels and REFUSES by name to be constructed at L2 or L3 (the execution rungs, a separate organ WARP-1206 W6; D2 start and stay at L0/L1, L3 disabled by default). propose requires L1: at the L0 investigate-only floor propose REFUSES by name and degrades down, never up (C3); investigate is available at both L0 and L1. The refusals carry positive controls so they cannot pass vacuously: construction at L0 and L1 succeeds, investigate returns a governed diagnosis at L0, and propose emits a validated proposal at L1.

selftests: 'construction at L0 (investigate) succeeds' and 'construction at L1 (propose) succeeds' (positive controls); 'construction at L2 is REFUSED by name (the execution rung is a SEPARATE organ, WARP-1206 W6)' and 'construction at L3 is REFUSED by name (L3 disabled by default, D2)'; 'propose REFUSES at the L0 floor and degrades down, never up (C3)'; 'investigate IS available at the L0 floor' and 'propose emits a warp.remedy/v1 proposal at L1' (positive controls).

DIAGNOSIS FROM ARTIFACTS, NEVER FABRICATED (O4/C1). Every citation must resolve to a REAL artifact in the assembled investigation context (a corpus artifact path the governance trace cites, a recorded change commit touching the governing spec footprint, or an evidence query the reasoner ACTUALLY issued and the broker ALLOWED, an audit entry) or the harness REFUSES by name (FABRICATED DIAGNOSIS REFUSED); a governed incident must cite at least one corpus artifact so it rests on the record and not on evidence alone. Graceful degradation with no PLAN-0011 architecture contract (C7): the corpus stands down to spec and git level (areas None, contract_present False) and the harness still reaches a cited diagnosis. At L1 the emitted warp.remedy/v1 proposal is VALIDATED structurally through the W1 contract (INC.validate_remedy plus INC.bind_remedy) so a proposal missing any element is refused (fail closed), and the required human authorization is DERIVED mechanically by the harness (irreversible or data_mutating forces two_key so the two-key path W7 has an exact binding, otherwise human_confirmation).

selftests: THE NO-FABRICATION TOOTH: 'a fabricated citation (resolves to no real artifact) is REFUSED by name' with the positive control 'a diagnosis citing only REAL corpus artifacts succeeds'; 'a diagnosis with no cited evidence is REFUSED'; 'a GOVERNED-incident diagnosis citing only an evidence query (no corpus artifact) is REFUSED'; 'an evidence query ACTUALLY issued and allowed (audited) grounds an evidence citation (evidence:source/template)'; THE GHOST-EVIDENCE TOOTH: 'a citation of an evidence query that was NOT issued is REFUSED'.
